subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this PR land now as the focused doctor auth-migration field-preservation fix, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape coverage or coordination with the other open auth-migration PRs first?
rationale: The patch is correct in source review, but it intentionally changes how sensitive credential material is carried through an upgrade migration, which is a compatibility and security-boundary choice for the auth owner to accept.

options.title: Land after auth-owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix with the existing before/after proof, then let exact-head CI and required branch refresh gate the merge.

options.title: Add shipped-shape coverage first
options.body: Ask for one more regression around a maintainer-confirmed shipped auth-profile shape before merging the migration change.

options.title: Coordinate with related auth PRs
options.body: Hold only if maintainers want this field-preservation fix bundled or sequenced with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93352.

recommendation.title: Land after auth-owner pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused parser-reuse fix with the existing before/after proof, then let exact-head CI and required branch refresh gate the merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration and the touched persistence/doctor files trace most strongly to steipete's merged auth refactor and follow-up history.
